answer: Histories are stored in summit, checked in pulse, and haven shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 10 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2240 identities would post 2129 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
